title: Plate 1: Situation of H.M.S. Resolute, Baffin's Bay, 26 June 1852
creator: after sketches by George Frederick McDougall
description: The Resolute among the floes of the middle pack in Baffin Bay on the outward passage of Belcher's squadron, the voyage that would end in the relief of McClure's Investigator crew.

title: Plate 2: Resolute and Intrepid passing a large iceberg, Baffin's Bay, July 1852
creator: after sketches by George Frederick McDougall
description: The sailing ship Resolute and the steam tender Intrepid working past a berg in Baffin Bay.

title: Plate 3: Loss of the American whaler M'Lellan, 8 July 1852
creator: after sketches by George Frederick McDougall
description: The whaler M'Lellan crushed and abandoned in the Baffin Bay pack, watched by the squadron - one of the everyday disasters of the whaling grounds the Navy sailed through.

title: Plate 4: Resolute and Intrepid in winter quarters, Melville Island, 1852-53
creator: after sketches by George Frederick McDougall
description: The two ships housed over for the winter at Dealy Island off Melville Island, the base from which the sledge parties that found McClure set out.

title: Plate 5: Departure of the travelling parties from Resolute and Intrepid, 4 April 1853
creator: after sketches by George Frederick McDougall
description: The sledge crews leaving the ships with flags flying on 4 April 1853. One of these parties, under Bedford Pim, reached the Investigator in Mercy Bay and brought McClure's men out.

title: Plate 6: Resolute under sail for the last time, 10 September 1853
creator: after sketches by George Frederick McDougall
description: The Resolute under canvas on 10 September 1853, before the ice closed for the second winter. She was abandoned the following May, drifted free, was found by an American whaler and returned to Britain as a gift.

title: Plate 7: Abandonment of the Resolute and Intrepid, 15 May 1854
creator: after sketches by George Frederick McDougall
description: The crews hauling away from the two ships left standing in the ice on Belcher's order, 15 May 1854 - the abandonment that led to Belcher's court martial and, four years on, to the Resolute's return under her own American salvage.

title: The Arctic squadron
creator: engraver unnamed
description: Woodcut of Belcher's five-ship squadron of 1852 under sail.

title: H.M.S. Resolute lying-to in the North Atlantic
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The Resolute hove to in an Atlantic gale on the outward passage.

title: Ice instruments
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The saws, ice anchors, chisels and claws with which a ship cut and warped her way through the pack - the working tools of Arctic navigation under sail.

title: Natives, Whale-fish Islands
creator: engraver unnamed
description: Greenlanders at the Whale-fish Islands (Kronprinsens Ejland) off Disko, where the squadron watered and took on dogs.

title: Esquimaux canoe (kayak)
creator: engraver unnamed
description: A Greenlandic kayak with its paddle and hunting gear, drawn at the Whale-fish Islands.

title: The Pioneer's accident and the Resolute's predicament
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The steam tender Pioneer in trouble and the Resolute nipped, in Baffin Bay.

title: Amusements on the ice
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The ships' companies at games on the floe, part of the deliberate winter routine against scurvy and low spirits.

title: Diagram of the Resolute's nip
creator: engraver unnamed
description: A measured diagram showing how the floes closed on the Resolute's hull and lifted her - the mechanics of a nip, drawn for readers who had never seen one.

title: Apparatus for sawing ice
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The rig of triangles, tackles and long saws with which a crew cut a dock or a canal through floe ice.

title: Diagram of an ice-dock
creator: engraver unnamed
description: Plan of a dock cut into a floe to shelter a ship from the moving pack.

title: Mirage, Baffin's Bay
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The looming and distortion of ships and bergs by refraction, a phenomenon that repeatedly misled Arctic navigators into charting land that was not there.

title: Esquimaux, Cape York
creator: engraver unnamed
description: Inughuit met at Cape York on the north Greenland shore, at the top of Melville Bay.

title: Balloon
creator: engraver unnamed
description: One of the message balloons flown from the search ships, carrying printed slips with the squadron's position in the hope that Franklin's people would find one.

title: Pursuit of science under difficulties
creator: engraver unnamed
description: Officers taking observations in the cold, at the magnetic and meteorological work that filled the winter.

title: Winter costumes
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The Navy's winter clothing as actually worn on Melville Island: a plate of some documentary value beside the Inuit clothing the same book illustrates.

title: Pursuit of a bear
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The crew chasing a polar bear over the floe near the winter quarters.

title: Remarkable snow cliff, Bridport Inlet, Melville Island
creator: engraver unnamed
description: A cliff of banked snow in Bridport Inlet, drawn on one of the local journeys from Dealy Island.

title: H.M. sledge Erin
creator: engraver unnamed
description: One of the Navy's man-hauled sledges rigged with its sail, named and flagged in the manner of the searching squadrons.

title: Cooking under difficulties
creator: engraver unnamed
description: A sledge crew at the spirit stove inside the tent, the daily struggle to melt water and thaw pemmican.

title: Graves on Dealy Island
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The graves of men of the squadron on Dealy Island, beside the great depot cairn left there for any party that might come after.

title: Interior of a tent
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The inside of a sledging tent with the party lying head to foot in their bags - how eight men slept on the march.

title: Packing the sledge preparatory to marching
creator: engraver unnamed
description: The morning routine of striking camp and lashing the load, drawn as an instruction as much as a scene.

title: Arctic travelling in the month of June
creator: engraver unnamed
description: Man-hauling through June thaw water on the floe, the worst going of the sledging season.

title: H.M. sledges, flags and mottoes
creator: engraver unnamed
description: A plate of the sledge banners of the searching squadrons, each party with its own device and motto, worked by the officers' families at home.

title: Description of the travelling parties, spring 1853
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: A ruled table naming each sledge party, its officer, its men, its object and the ground it was to cover in the spring of 1853 - the search plan that found McClure.

title: Table of positions for the track of H.M.S. Resolute, 1852
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: The appendix table of the Resolute's daily positions on the 1852 passage: date, latitude, longitude, and remarks. This is the raw material of the ship's track.

title: Table of positions for the track of H.M.S. North Star, Beechey Island to England, 1854
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: Appendix table of the North Star's homeward positions in 1854, when she carried the crews of five abandoned ships out of the Arctic.

title: Tables of temperature
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: The appendix temperature register kept through the winters at Dealy Island - the daily maxima, minima and means that were the expedition's most durable scientific product.

title: M'Clintock's experiments with travelling kettles and lamps, and the scheme of fuel for a party of eleven
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: McClintock's measured trials of cooking apparatus, with the fuel allowance worked out per man per day for an eleven-man sledge party. Sledging efficiency in the 1850s came down to arithmetic like this.

title: Equipment for a travelling party of eight (one officer and seven men)
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: The complete itemised outfit of an eight-man sledge party, weight by weight: tent, bags, cooking gear, instruments, arms, spare gear.

title: List of clothing taken by a party proceeding on a long journey
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: Exactly what each man carried on his back and in his bag for a spring journey of six weeks or more - the clothing list, garment by garment.

title: Tent for eight men, and dimensions of a tent for eleven men
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: The measured specification of the sledging tents, with the dimensions for the eight-man and eleven-man patterns.

title: Dealy Island, summer 1853: tides, thickness of ice, and the close of the navigable season
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: A page of the appendix gathering the tidal observations at Dealy Island, the measured ice thickness through 1853-54, and the date the navigable season closed - the kind of local record a ship working these waters today can still compare against.

title: Land discovered and searched from 1848 to 1854
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: The tally, expedition by expedition, of coastline discovered and coastline actually searched in the seven years of the Franklin search.

title: Abstracted list of game procured during various voyages in the Arctic regions
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: A comparative table of the game shot by successive expeditions - muskox, caribou, bear, hare, ptarmigan, duck - the fresh meat that stood between a crew and scurvy.

title: Meteorological abstracts
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: The appendix meteorological abstract: pressure, temperature, wind and weather reduced to monthly means for the wintering.

title: Compendium of the travelling operations of spring 1853
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: Party by party, the distances marched, the days out and the ground covered in the great sledging season of 1853.

title: Abstract of travelling operations, autumn 1852 and spring 1853
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: The summary abstract of all sledge journeys from the Resolute and Intrepid.

title: Game list and meat account
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: What was shot and what was eaten: the game list beside the meat account, pound by pound, for the two winters.

title: Animals
creator: George Frederick McDougall
description: The closing appendix list of animals met with, a working natural history of Melville Island as the squadron found it.
